documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Shringar House of Mangalsutra reported strong operational and financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, with Q2 revenue from operations reaching INR 818.7 crores and sales volume growing 10% YoY to 577 kgs. The company is in the process of setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand into lightweight jewelry, silver, platinum, and lab-grown diamonds across B2B and online B2C channels. Management has expanded manufacturing capacity from 2.5 tonnes to 4 tonnes and is focusing on scaling its corporate business share from 51% to 65% to improve cash flow cycles. Additionally, entry into the bridal jewelry segment has shown encouraging traction, accounting for approximately 10% of total manufacturing volume within six months of launch. Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited presented its investor presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27, reporting H1 FY27 revenue from operations of ₹1,367.15 crore, a growth of 58.7% YoY.

guidance.claim: Management targets scaling its corporate business share from 51% to 65%.
guidance.quote: By doing so, We are targeting to scale our corporate business share from 51% to 65% in the coming days.

guidance.claim: Scaling corporate business share is expected to improve the company's business rolling cycle by at least 1.5 times.
guidance.quote: This will improve our business rolling cycle by at least 1.5 times.

guidance.claim: Management expects the bridal jewelry business to potentially reach a level comparable to its core business within two to two-and-a-half years.
guidance.quote: This share s expected to continue growing; in fact, within two to two-and-a-half years, it could potentially reach a level comparable to our core business.

guidance.claim: The company expects production to ramp up in the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: The production is expected to ramp up in the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment remains encouraging driven by the ongoing festive and wedding season.
demand_outlook.quote: Coming to the industry, the demand environment remains encouraging, particularly with the festive and wedding season underway.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for lightweight jewellery, contemporary designs, and affordable products continues to create market opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for the lightweight jewellery, contemporary design, and affordable products continues to create opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: More than 90% of revenue is generated through repeat orders from existing customers.
The expansion plans of corporate clientele are expected to drive additional demand for the company's products.
demand_outlook.quote: The expansion plans of our corporate clientele will drive additional demand for our products

demand_outlook.claim: The company utilizes outsourced manufacturing alongside internal capacity to handle growing product demand.
demand_outlook.quote: To meet growing demand, the company complements its in-house capacity with outsourced production.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand across the broader jewellery value chain.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term expansion strategy, we are in the process of setting up a wholly-owned subsidiary to expand our presence across the broader jewellery value chain.

capex_expansion.claim: The new subsidiary will be initialized with a capital deployment of INR 2 crores to INR 5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We can, but for this, we have thought that first we open a subsidiary with a very minimal fund, like INR2 crores, INR4 crores, INRS crores at most, since it is a new venture.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested approximately ₹15 crore via internal accruals to expand capacity, upgrade machinery, improve efficiency, and meet growing demand.
capex_expansion.quote: Approx. ₹15 crore invested via internal accruals to expand capacity, upgrade machinery, improve efficiency, and meet growing demand.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans strategic expansion through the establishment of a wholly owned subsidiary.
capex_expansion.quote: Establishment of a wholly owned subsidiary

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened branch offices in Delhi and Pune to support geographic expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: Opened branch offices in Delhi and Pune

margins_costs.claim: Q2 gross profit increased by 53.1% YoY to INR 68 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit for the quarter at INR68 crores, an increase of 53.1% Y-0-Y.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 EBITDA grew 68.7% YoY to INR 54.9 crores with an EBITDA margin of 6.7%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR54.9 crores, a 68.7% growth Y-0-Y, while EBITDA margin stood at 6.7%, a growth of 50 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Higher gold prices improve company profitability as manufacturing fees are charged on a percentage basis.
margins_costs.quote: If gold prices increase, our profitability actually improves.

margins_costs.claim: Employee costs increased due to headcount expansion required for higher manufacturing capacity and new bridal segment operations.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, as I mentioned, we have already increased our capacity from 2.5 to 4 tonnes; consequently, we will need to increase our headcount.

margins_costs.claim: PAT grew 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore in H1 FY27, with a PAT margin of 5.37%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT grew 43.1% YoY to ₹73.47 crore, with a PAT margin of 5.37%.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for Q2 FY27 reached 577 kgs, representing a 10% YoY increase.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume for the quarter stood at 577 kgs, up by 10% Y-0-Y.

orders_capacity.claim: Manufacturing capacity has been expanded from 2.5 tonnes to 4 tonnes.
orders_capacity.quote: Sir, as I mentioned, we have already increased our capacity from 2.5 to 4 tonnes; consequently, we will need to increase our headcount.

orders_capacity.claim: Major corporate chain stores currently account for 51% of the company's business share.
orders_capacity.quote: As you have seen, we have reached around 51% business share with major corporate chain stores in India, such as Titan and others.

orders_capacity.claim: The bridal jewellery segment accounts for approximately 10% of total manufacturing operations.
orders_capacity.quote: So, within our entire manufacturing operations, the bridal jewellery segment accounts for approximately 10%.

orders_capacity.claim: Following the capacity addition in February 2026, the blended capacity for FY26 was 2,625 kgs with an actual capacity utilization of 87%.
orders_capacity.quote: The new capacity was added in February 2026. Blended capacity for full year is 2625 kgs. Hence, actual capacity utilization is 87%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company complements its in-house manufacturing capacity with outsourced production to meet growing demand.
orders_capacity.quote: To meet growing demand, the company complements its in-house capacity with outsourced production.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains an integrated manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of 4,000 kg.
orders_capacity.quote: 4,000 kg p.a Capacity in an integrated manufacturing facility

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flow management is currently the top priority for company management.
capital_allocation.quote: Limited cash flow management is our top priority today.

capital_allocation.claim: The company holds approximately 400 kgs of gold inventory.
capital_allocation.quote: Approximately 400 kgs is our inventory, 400 kgs.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a gold inventory hedge ratio in the range of 30% to 35%.
capital_allocation.quote: Thus, we maintain a hedge in the range of 30% to 35%.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash outflow from operating activities improved to -₹77.91 crore from -₹412.11 crore, supported by lower working capital outflow.
capital_allocation.quote: Net cash outflow from operating activities improved to -₹77.91 crore from -₹412.11 crore, supported by lower working capital outflow.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's operations are working capital intensive, requiring liquidity and funds to support business expansion and diversification.
capital_allocation.quote: Our operations are working capital intensive, requiring adequate liquidity and funds to support business expansion and diversification across multiple locations

capital_allocation.claim: Listing of the company enabled growth funds for business operations.
capital_allocation.quote: Listing of the company enabled growth funds

risks_headwinds.claim: Gold price volatility and uncertainty have rendered consumers more cautious about their spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: We are also seeing growing preferences for organized and branded jewellery, while volatility and uncertainty in gold price have made consumers more cautious about their spending.
